in_sanskrit.name: श्रयन्
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who protects, supports, maintains, upholds
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who protects, supports, maintains, upholds, preserves, and nourishes. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'shri' which means to protect, preserve, or prosper.

in_hindi.name: श्रयन
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who keeps things correct or safe, maintains or upholds something. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'shri' which means to protect, preserve, or prosper.

in_tamil.name: ஶ்ரயன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who makes things happen as they should, brings things to fruition, or makes things correct or safe. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'shri' which means to protect, preserve, or prosper.

in_telugu.name: శ్రేయన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the lord of wealth, prosperity, or fortune. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'shri' which means to protect, preserve, or prosper.

in_marathi.name: Shrayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shrayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘shruti’ meaning ‘that which is heard’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is referred to as Shreyas or Shreyaan, the one who bestows knowledge and wisdom.

vedic_reference.note: Shrayan is a name found in various Hindu scriptures and mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'shri', which is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Shrayan is also associated with the deity Vishnu, who is known as the preserver of the universe.
